title: Lazurio application preparation declaration
description: Declared in an application package.json under `lazurio.preparation`. Says how the application is prepared before its single-process start (Lazurio Module Standard, manual/module-standard.md, decision 0171). Scripts name package scripts, never shell commands. The grammar of `owner_package` and script names equals the LazurioPlatform reader `parsePreparationDeclaration` (F25) so that a declaration this schema accepts is one the Platform accepts, except the reserved Python form (`pyproject.toml`, `runtime: uv`), which the Platform reads only from the release that adds the uv adapter.

runtime.description: Toolchain that installs dependencies and runs the scripts: `bun` (default; frozen install from bun.lock beside owner_package) or `uv` (Python; `uv sync --frozen` from uv.lock, scripts run through `uv run`).

uv_version.description: Exact uv version the Environment must provide; required when runtime is `uv`.

owner_package.description: Module-relative POSIX path of the package that owns the preparation: `app/v<N>/package.json` for a Bun App, `app/v<N>/pyproject.toml` for a Python App (`[tool.lazurio]`). Same character set and traversal rule as the LazurioPlatform reader (`parsePreparationDeclaration`), plus at least one directory segment: the App never sits in the Module root.

prepare_script.description: Optional idempotent package script that does everything the start must not: client build, data generation, symlinks, migrations. Same name grammar as the LazurioPlatform reader; never an npm lifecycle name (`bun install` runs those by itself). Convention: `prepare:app`.

check_script.description: Read-only package script that exits 0 when the application is prepared and non-zero otherwise. Same name grammar as the LazurioPlatform reader; never an npm lifecycle name. Convention: `check:prepared`.
